verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any natural-language command interface for operating x402 or the CDP Facilitator, such as an NL console, assistant, or prompt-driven setup. The Bazaar MCP server, which lets agents discover services through tool calls, and the agent wallets are separate agent-integration capabilities. They are adjacent building blocks, not first-party natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
